newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - July 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - July 24.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Defence Minister Alain Richard in an interview says he favours closer ties between Dassault and Aerospatiale but hopes this can be achieved while maintaining Aerospatiale in the public sector.

He also confirms cancelling previous government's plans requiring all young men and women to attend a five-day training and information period with the military, intends to replace it with a one-day session.
-- Blue-chip CAC 40 index rises above 3,000 following Wall Street.
-- Deutsche Bank considers acquisition in the French banking sector.
